props.caption: North Korea disclosed a new nuclear-materials factory and expansion of another, but did not identify either location.
Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted two missiles toward Riyadh and two drones over the Eastern Province.
Parliament approved a critical-medicines framework that still needs Council approval before it becomes EU law.

items.note: Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted two ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh.

lead.what: Kim inspected one newly inaugurated nuclear-materials factory and another being expanded, while their locations were not disclosed.
Saudi-led coalition forces said they destroyed two ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh and two drones over the Eastern Province.
Parliament approved a critical-medicines deal that still needs Council approval before it becomes EU law.

rest.what: USTR proposed Section 301 tariffs for public comment after determinations covering fourteen economies.
The higher third-quarter growth revision and October PCE readings cover different periods before the Federal Reserve’s December meeting.
